t: From AI Hallucination to Hard Language: Upgrading My Prompt Fu
s: This article details a real-world case study in human-AI collaboration, where a developer evolves from simply using AI to instrumenting the AI interaction process. It chronicles identifying an AI hallucination due to incomplete context and then co-developing a programmatic guardrail for robust, automated workflow improvement.
sub: AI hallucination diagnosis and resolution via context enrichment
Programmatic guardrail development for AI interaction safety
Shift from AI usage to AI process instrumentation for workflow automation
Case study in evolving human-AI collaboration through code refactoring
